t: How people lived: life expectancy, child deaths, family size, poverty and emissions since 1800
src: Gapminder (Fast Track) compiled from UN, World Bank, Riley, Human Mortality Database and others
about: The basic material conditions of life in every country since 1800. Before about 1950 many values are reconstructions by historians and demographers, so treat early numbers as estimates.
q: When did life expectancy start rising in Britain, Japan, India and Nigeria?
How did child mortality change in China before and after 1949, and after 1978?

src: Gapminder, legal status of slavery by country
about: How many of today’s countries had legal slavery in each year. Legal abolition did not always end slavery in practice.
